_meta.description: Provenance for the official CME Group contract-specification page of every future in this repository's pool. Each record stores the exact response body under data/cme_specs/ with its SHA-256 and byte length; the transcribed fields are re-extractable from that body offline. A missing field is null and listed in missing_fields - it is never inferred from another product.
_meta.provenance_note: The per-record 'reason' values in this index do NOT record the real transport error. The lane's offline re-extraction step ran after a run that stored no HTML at all and rewrote every record's reason to '<PRODUCT>.html not stored yet; run without --offline' before the commit step ran, so the underlying failure text was lost (capture_environment 'local' and workflow_run_url null are the fingerprints of that offline pass). The fact that survives is captured_count 0 of 20. The workflow step is fixed: it now skips the offline pass entirely when nothing arrived over the network and restores the network index unconditionally. No reason text has been reconstructed or guessed here.
